name: eth_call
description: If the execution reverts, or ends with an exception such as a failing native contract call or running out of gas, the method returns error -32015 instead of a result. A revert reports `VM Exception while processing transaction: revert <reason>` or `VM Exception while processing transaction: transaction reverted`. An exception reports `VM Exception while processing transaction: execution failed`. This holds whether or not RSKIP692 is active.
summary: Executes a new message call (locally) immediately without creating a transaction on the block chain.

result.name: returnValue
result.description: The return value of the executed contract
